# GovernAI — AI Governance, Compliance & Responsible AI

> GovernAI (OPC Pvt. Ltd.) helps governments, universities, and enterprises
> deploy AI responsibly through ISO/IEC 42001 auditing, compliance advisory,
> and capacity building programs across India.

## Core Services

- **AI Governance Academy** — Capacity building & training for government officials, policymakers, and enterprise leaders
- **AI Compliance & Auditing** — ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act compliance frameworks
- **Policy & Advisory** — AI policy drafting and strategic advisory for governments & enterprises

## Key Facts

- 2,500+ government officials trained across India
- 20+ institutional partnerships (IITs, NITs, UPSC, government bodies)
- Presence across 5+ Indian states & union territories
- Founded by Parishrut Jassal (TEDx Speaker, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor)
- Headquartered in New Delhi, India

## Domains of Expertise

1. Capacity Building & Training
2. AI Risk Assessment & Mitigation
3. Compliance Advisory (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF)
4. Policy Frameworks & Governance Design
5. Advocacy & Public Consultation
